2021: This initiative at the national level focused on advocating for passing the law on safe abortion.2022: This includes participation in UPR processes and implementation of decrees of the SR law.2023 (first half): This includes speaking out in defense of LGBTQI rights at a meeting called by the government.

2023 (second half): Total 6. This includes a roundtable with the Ministry of Justice and Ministry of Social Affairs on the visibility of trans as well as UPR activities.2024: Total 6. This includes a press café with the Ministry of Health, Family and Justice on the progress made in promoting SRHR in Benin, a conference of LGBT organisations on the UPR follow up, amongst others.

During an organised advocacy dinner by a coalition partner, political and administrative authorities committed to implementing the two Universal Periodic Review (UPR) recommendations related to sexual orientation and gender identity accepted by the government

Right Here Right Now Benin successfully encouraged the government to accept an additional UPR recommendation related to the rights of LGBTQI+ people. The two recommendations relating to LGBTQI+ issues and themes related to sexual orientation, gender identity and expression
